title: Wynn Hosts 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards Kick-Off Event in Shanghai

body_markdown:
**Macao, November 11, 2026** — On November 9 in Shanghai, Wynn hosted a Kick-Off Event for the 2027 *Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards* , an initiative by "Wynn Signature" – the exclusive lifestyle brand at Wynn. Themed "Three Years in the Making, A New Chapter Begins", the event marked the beginning of a new chapter for one of the most prominent international professional competitions dedicated to Chinese wine, bringing together the industry as it looks ahead to the 2027 edition.


Since its launch in 2024, the *Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards* has made Macao its home base while extending its professional judging, industry exchange, and Chinese wine promotion across China and onto the international stage. As a UNESCO "Creative City of Gastronomy" and a vibrant crossroads of East-West cultures, Macao continues to serve as an important bridge for the competition's international outreach, taking Chinese wines to global audiences through Macao while bringing international industry attention and engagement back to the city. This two-way exchange aims to foster deeper exchange and development across the wine, gastronomy and tourism sectors.


**Wynn reveals 2027 roadmap: A new chapter for the globalization of Chinese wine**
Around 130 Chinese winery representatives, industry leaders and media guests from across China gathered for the 2027 *Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards* Kick-Off Event at Roof 325, atop the Shanghai History Museum. Set against panoramic views of the Shanghai skyline, the evening brought the industry together in a relaxed cocktail setting, with guests sampling close to 100 Chinese wines from 75 wineries while exchanging perspectives on the continued development and international opportunities for Chinese wine.


At the event, Wynn officially announced the 2027 *Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards* full-year calendar, setting a clear blueprint for the upcoming competition


-


March 1: Entries and wine sample submissions open


-


August 21-25: Judging Week takes place in Beijing


-


October 29: Annual Awards Ceremony takes place in Macao


The following day, coinciding with the start of ProWine Shanghai 2026, Wynn invited Xing Wei MW – Panel Chair for the 2026 *Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards* – to host a masterclass titled "Hidden Gems Revealed: 3 Years, 15 Regions – Redrawing China's Wine Map". Drawing on valuable insights gained through the competition's exploration of 15 provinces across China over the past three years, Xing Wei MW brought extensive on-the-ground experience from his visits to key wine-producing regions throughout China. With his expertise in wine judging and tasting, he offered participants an overarching perspective on the evolving landscape of Chinese wine and the distinctive qualities that define its diverse regions.


**Wine Paris 2027: Championing Chinese wines on the global stage**
Looking ahead to 2027, the *Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards* will support the expansion of Chinese wineries into global markets by establishing a dedicated Chinese wine pavilion at Wine Paris 2027, taking place from February 15 to 17. Drawing on Wynn's strengths and resources across gastronomy, culture and its international network, the initiative will bring together leading Chinese wineries at this major international wine trade exhibition. Through a diverse program of showcases, industry exchanges, and food-and-wine pairing experiences, Wynn aims to present the quality and distinctive terroirs of Chinese wines to the global wine community while highlighting the significant progress the industry has made in recent years.


**Driving the global dialogue for Chinese wine**
As preparations for the next edition continue, post-competition promotional events for the 2026 *Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards* are also well underway, extending the competition's reach beyond professional judging to foster international exchange and promote the global development of Chinese wines.


From October 12 to 16, Wynn participated in the 47th World Congress of Vine and Wine and the General Assembly of the International Organisation of Vine and Wine (OIV) in Yinchuan, Ningxia. At the Congress, Wynn hosted a dedicated exhibition booth featuring award-winning wines from previous editions of the *Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards* , presenting the distinctive qualities of China's leading wine-producing regions to an international audience of wine experts, buyers and media. The exhibition drew considerable interest from international delegates, with the quality, diversity and distinctive regional expressions of Chinese wines generating strong engagement and discussion.


For the first time in its century-long history, the OIV held its World Congress in Asia, with China as the host country. The milestone event provided a premier international platform to showcase Chinese wines and raise their global profile. Wynn's participation further strengthened the global recognition and influence of the *Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards* as a professional platform, while fostering greater dialogue and connections between China's wine industry and international markets.
